title: Reassign lead technician dialog looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and See financial data, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is 1440 px wide, with the browser zoom at 100%.
  • The design picture DC-20-reassign-dialog-light-1440.png is open beside the app at 100% zoom (actual size); it is attached to this case.
  • In the design pictures the names, numbers, dates and amounts are sample data, and the rank numbers (1, 2, 3 …) beside rows and cards are left out of this release, so do not compare those.
  • The design's dialog title reads "Reassign Lead Tech" and it has no Unassigned row; the PRD names the action Reassign lead technician and offers Unassigned, so compare the layout and look only.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC20 Bea Dialog) is an active technician at {Location-A} who has a profile photo.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC20 Cal Dialog) is an active technician at {Location-A} who has no profile photo.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST DC20 Reassign Dialog") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17854) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter, Assigned to me is off, Search is empty and density is Regular (the default).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Tech View in the display switcher.
  2. Hover {Work-order-1}'s row.
  3. Click the three-dot button at the right end of the row.
  4. Click Reassign lead technician.
  5. Look at the dialog from top to bottom.
  6. Type the first three letters of {Technician-B}'s first name in the dialog's search box.
  7. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: a white dialog with rounded corners sits over a dimmed page: a title, and under it the work order number and the customer in grey; an X at the top right; a search box with a magnifier icon; a list where each row has a round avatar, the name and a grey "N open" line under it ({Technician-A}'s row shows the photo, {Technician-B}'s a light-grey circle with initials); {Technician-A}'s row, the current lead, is tinted light blue with a blue check mark; Unassigned is offered too; a Cancel button at the bottom right. The layout matches the design picture.
  • Step 6: the list narrows to the technicians whose names match.
  • Step 7: the dialog closes and {Work-order-1} still has {Technician-A} as its lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 52 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R12, S4-R15 and S4-R4, read 14 Oct 2026; Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", state states__work-orders__tech-reassign-dialog__light__1440 (design pictures DC-20-reassign-dialog-light-1440.png, rendered from that export at the width in the name), read 14 Oct 2026. Where the PRD says nothing about the look, the design is the source. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

The PRD still lists the Reassign dialog's content, search, grouping, avatars and N open count under design updates required; whether the 14 Oct dialog is final is open with the product owner (question PQ-V08, not yet answered). The design has no Unassigned row; this case follows the PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R12: “The dialog offers eligible active technicians in the current location and Unassigned.”
  • S4-R15: “The dialog’s N open count includes Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review, and Complete work orders.”
  • S4-R4: “The card or row more-actions menu opens the Reassign lead technician dialog.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Reassign dialog: “width: 480px; max-width: 100%; max-height: 78vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--sv-surface);”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Reassign dialog backdrop: “background: rgba(15, 17, 26, 0.5);”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Reassign dialog search: “placeholder="Search technicians"”
